policies.policy_name: Authorization Requirement for Knowledge Link Deletion
policies.description: User must have full CRUD permissions on the Knowledge table and must be in role Agent, Manager, or Administrator to delete a knowledge link; the Reporter role is prohibited. If the user lacks these permissions, abort with a 403 Forbidden error.
references: Full CRUD on Incidents, Service Requests, Tasks, Work Notes, CMDB, Change, Problem, and Knowledge. READ access to all the tables.
Full CRUD on operational tables (incident, problem, change, knowledge); READ access to all the tables.
Cannot view or modify records opened by other users, CMDB, or internal work notes.

policies.description: Users with the Reporter role may only view knowledge articles that are in the published state.
references: Only articles in knowledge.state = published are searchable by the Reporter role.
Cannot view or modify records opened by other users, CMDB, or internal work notes.

policies.policy_name: Identifier Validation for Knowledge Link Removal
policies.description: A removal request must include either the incident‑knowledge link ID (incident_kb_id) or both incident_id and knowledge_id; if only incident_id and knowledge_id are provided, perform a lookup to retrieve and verify the correct incident_kb_id before removal.
references: Mandatory Fields: Any request to create or update a record must validate all mandatory fields.
User Clarification: If a mandatory field is missing, state which field is required.
When identifiers such as names or IDs are missing, perform lookups, verify that you are reusing correct values from previous responses, and proceed using the retrieved data.

policies.description: The operation must not disclose or act upon any knowledge article that is outside the authenticated user's access scope.
references: Knowledge Scope: Do not disclose information that is outside the authenticated user's access scope.

policies.description: The removal of a knowledge link must be performed as a single validated operation; no additional actions may be combined in the same call.
references: Perform one validated operation at a time, except when using approved batch endpoints.

policies.description: The tool must not fabricate or guess incident_kb_id, incident_id, or knowledge_id values; the identifiers must be verified against the system before removal.
references: Never assume or fabricate IDs, responses, or outcomes — rely solely on verified API results.

policies.description: If any policy in this document is violated when attempting to remove a knowledge link, the operation must be halted and the specific policy reason returned before any action is taken.
references: Policy Violation: If a user request violates any rule herein, you must halt the operation and provide the specific policy reason before pausing.

policies.description: Before performing any operation, the assistant must check the user information and operate exclusively based on confirmed user roles.
references: First you must check the user information and operate exclusively based on confirmed user roles, verified record relationships, and ITIL/database integrity rules.

policies.description: The assistant must ensure that the incident and knowledge article involved in the removal belong to the same organization and have a valid relationship before deleting the link.
references: First you must check the user information and operate exclusively based on confirmed user roles, verified record relationships, and ITIL/database integrity rules.

policies.description: The assistant may proceed with the removal operation without requesting additional confirmation or permission once all validations have passed.
references: You do not need to ask for confirmation or permission before taking action.

policies.description: If a rate‑limit error is encountered, the assistant must pause and retry the request using exponential backoff rather than failing immediately.
references: Rate Limiting: If exceeded, pause and retry using Exponential Backoff.

policies.description: If a removal request is ambiguous (e.g., both incident_kb_id and incident_id/knowledge_id are provided, or required identifiers are unclear), the assistant must not ask for clarification but must return the list of possible interpretations and state the ambiguity.
references: User Clarification: Do not ask for further information. If the request is ambiguous, return the list and state the ambiguity.

policies.description: If the removal of a knowledge link encounters a record locking or state conflict, the assistant must return a 409 Conflict error instead of proceeding.
references: 409 Conflict: Record locking or state conflict.

policies.policy_name: Audit Logging for Knowledge Link Removal
policies.description: Every removal of a knowledge link from an incident must be recorded in the system audit log, including the timestamp (created_on) of the action and the user_id of the assistant performing the operation.
references: Time Tracking: All work logs must include the timestamp (created_on) and the user_id performing the action.
